subject: 登封观星台 · 台体与石圭正面
author: Gary Todd from Xinzheng, China
source_note: Gary Todd于2010年拍摄的正面照片，保留双室、中缝、两侧台阶与向前延伸的石圭。
prompt: Create a precise architectural contour drawing of Dengfeng's 1276 Gaocheng astronomical observatory, directly from photograph2. Photo1 Longmen is line STYLE ONLY. This is NOT a temple or pagoda. Straight NORTH elevation of a massive tapering brick platform, its two symmetrical sloped masses separated by a very narrow tall vertical observation slot running from ground to the roof. At top are two low rectangular brick chambers, one small round-headed window per chamber, flat-looking tiled eave/ridge along the top edge and a rectangular gap between the chambers crossed by the horizontal gnomon. On each outer side is the stairway returning on a low angular stair wall; precisely preserve the trapezoid silhouette and both diagonal stairway/parapet outlines seen in photo. Long low narrow stone measuring gui projects from the slot towards viewer, with incised parallel channels, natural restrained perspective. Include the whole measuring ruler and both side stair bodies, not courtyard. Keep overall proportions and geometries from actualphoto; do not add ornate eaves, towers, extra windows, statues or fantasy astronomical instruments. Remove trees, ground paving, tourists and signs. Airy delicate black contour, sparse short brick cues only, 95% of wall white, no fill/gray/shadows/hatching; narrow slot must remain white bounded by lines. site_recommendation.name: 登封观星台
site_recommendation.lede: 砖石台体分成两室，一线狭缝朝向延伸在地面的石圭。登封观星台把测影所需的高度、方向和刻度，组织成一座清楚可读的建筑。
facts: 观星台始建于元至元十三年（1276），与郭守敬主持的大规模测天工作有关。
台顶双室之间留出测影狭缝，北侧铺设石圭，台旁双梯可通台顶。
图版只画观星台本体与石圭，附近周公测景台未另拆为条目。
